items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: We had another one... This same fella, Frog, we called him Frog... On trombone... He's still a sweet guy. Yeah, he's still playing nice.

ctx.x: Many of the members? Uh, Kerry Levine was a saxophone player. He was a sweet saxophone player. Very young. He was about 19 or 20. He was very young. And, uh... We had another one about the name of... I can't recall his name now, but he was a sweet alto also. And... Little Johnny, or Johnny or Little John, he lives uptown now. He's always on the road. He was a sweet trumpet player. Very young stuff. Very young stuff. He was a sweet trumpet player, and still is a sweet trumpet player. His name was John, John…

We called him Frog. He's a cripple. On trombone. He was a sweet... He's still a sweet guy. Yeah, he's still playing nice. He's still a sweet guy. Well, we called him Frog. And, uh... It's a trumpet player by the name of Lucky.
